text:
nina: Summarizing Opal postmortem follow-ups. Root cause: on-prem NAT asymmetry + intermittent BGP route flap caused connection sticky state to break and triggered tenant-level evictions in the Dedicated pool. I pulled action items below.
sam: Thanks. Quick list + owners?
nina: Short list: infra peering hardening, runtime defensive drain + recon, harness for regression, customer coordination, and a monthly pattern scan.
raj: I'll own infra peering hardening (TKT-6020). Plan: tighten prefix filters, add quick health TCP probe to peering endpoints, and add a canary allowlist for DROP rules. Target PR Thu EOD, canary Sat 02:00-03:00 UTC.
devex: I'll build a small harness (TKT-6021) to reproduce asymmetric NAT + BGP flap scenarios. ETA harness Wed. Will add a nightly regression that asserts no tenant-wide eviction.
nina: Runtime work (TKT-6022) needs to implement graceful drain on peer-change and a short recon window to avoid mass connection churn. Raj, can you coordinate the canary gating with runtime?
raj: Yes. We'll require a 1-hour canary on 5% of peered prefixes first. Rollback is reverting new iptables rules and probe toggle.
sre-bot: deploy-bot: created tickets TKT-6020, TKT-6021, TKT-6022 by nina.
sam: Success criteria: 1) synthetic flap test shows zero tenant isolation for 5m, 2) eviction rate <= 1e-4 during canary, 3) regression test added to nightly CI. Add those to tickets.
nina: Done. I've added the criteria into the tickets and into the postmortem doc link (internal doc).
devex: For the harness I'll include probe scripts and a log matcher that verifies per-tenant eviction spikes. Will push a demo in Wed sync.
raj: Infra snippet for reviewers (will gate behind allowlist):
```
# simple filter to prefer established + drop unexpected returns
iptables -A INPUT -s <peer-cidr> -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED -j ACCEPT
iptables -A INPUT -s <peer-cidr> -j DROP
```
raj: Note: drop only after N minutes of canary and allowlist.
sam: Also add a recurring monthly scan TKT-6023 to surface customers with repeated peering/isolation indicators. Set initial cadence and owner.
nina: I'll own the pattern scan TKT-6023 and add it to the ops calendar.
raj: Timeline recap: TKT-6021 harness Wed, TKT-6022 runtime prototype Thu, TKT-6020 PR Thu EOD, canary Sat 02:00-03:00 UTC.
sre-bot: oncall: monitoring dashboard link will be added to each PR.
nina: Thanks all. I'll create the sprint cards and calendar invite for Thu handoff. Ping me to reassign. :thumbsup:
